folds.text: Inside a session, type `/` to see the commands available. You do not need to memorise them. `/help` lists what you can use.
`/clear` starts a new conversation with empty context. Use it between unrelated tasks. `/resume` brings back an earlier conversation if you need it.
`/compact` frees up space by summarising the conversation so far, and you can tell it what to keep. `/context` shows what is using space.
`/init` creates a starter **CLAUDE.md** for your project. `/memory` lets you edit those files. `/plan` jumps straight into plan mode.
Made a mess? `/rewind` rolls the code, the conversation, or both back to an earlier point. Press `Esc` twice for the same menu. It works alongside git, not instead of it.
